title: Nootka Convention
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Nootka Convention", at revision 1360627683, opens: "The Nootka Sound Conventions were a series of three agreements between the Kingdom of Spain and the Kingdom of Great Britain, signed in the 1790s, which averted a war between the two countries over overlapping claims to portions of the Pacific Northwest coast of North America." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1648086, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1790–1794 Spanish–British agreements to settle overlapping claims in northwestern America". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
